name: Syntec Optics Holdings, Inc.
summary: Syntec Optics Holdings, Inc. manufactures and supplies optics and photonics components, sub-systems, and optical systems for defense, medical, industrial, and consumer end-markets in the United States and Europe. It offers polymer-based optics; and optical assemblies, electro-optics assemblies, molded polymer and glass optic components, opto-mechanical components, nano machining, and thin films coating. The company also provides optics assembly, electro-optics assembly, design, and coating services.
